log.msg: Ten-second test at 1280: STRANGER - A list of eleven single words (Journey, Padding, Scale, Layout, Navigation, Color, Type, Controls, Vocabulary, System, Themes) under one caption sentence about a camera - I cannot tell what any of them show or which to click first. MEANT (from description + page.js comment): a design-study program - a headless camera walked the whole site overnight, Journey is every screenshot it took, and each of the other pages asks those screenshots one question (padding, scale, layout, navigation, color, type, controls, themes). The two sentences differ: the page never says any of that, it just names the studies and leaves the reader to guess what a click on Padding or Scale produces.

FIX 1 - design/page.js: rewrote the takeaway sentence in plain words (what Journey is, what the other cards do, what to click); added width:full + index:true + this.previews() so the 11 children render as a tile-wall of cards (icon+description) instead of a bare word list in a 40em lane - matches the width word every one of its own children already wears (padding, layout, navigation, color, type, controls, vocabulary, system, scale, journey all set width:full) and fixes the exact finding in paging/critique REALMS[design]: 31% of 3440 used, 2180px dead, bare vocabulary list, alt = tile wall (the pattern padding/ and layout/ already build). Also removed initialize(){ this.columns() } - dead code, confirmed inert by DOM class (page--design carried class page column not page columns) and by columns.md doc/vocabulary/page.js comment: a nested columns() call is inert once an ancestor (/imagine/) already hosts. CAVEAT: assumed index:true + previews() is the right fix because three sibling realms (shells, screens, vary) already use exactly this pattern for the same problem (bare list at columns-host width); undo if the owner wants design/ to read as prose instead of a card wall.

Layout at 3440, critique row for design (paging/critique REALMS): rank 4, m: 31% wide, 2180px dead, depth 4, scroll 1392/1392, score 99, weak: bare vocabulary list in a 40em lane, alt: Tile wall (padding/, layout/ already build it). BEFORE re-measured live: matches the row exactly. AFTER FIX 1: width used 97% (wall right edge 3390px of 3440), dead px ~50 on each side (the columns own inset, not waste), intro paragraph 648px wide at 16.2px font = exactly 40em (measure cap holding, not exceeded). Alternate WAS APPLIED, not reverted - tile wall via previews(), matching the alt text verbatim. Invariant 1 (no x:0 content): pass, first content at x=48.6px (column inset), the left rail collapses into the crumb strip under width:full same as every sibling. Invariant 2 (no line past ~40em): pass, measured exactly 40em, framework measure cap. Invariant 3 (no hardcoded spacing where a clamp exists): checked all page.js/css under this realm - only per-card em gaps (0.3-1.2em) inside grids, which is the padding studys own recommended range (2-12% of a boxs own width), not page-rhythm literals that duplicate --pad-default/--gap-default; the one new style call added (--column: 20em on the previews wall) is the documented per-wall retuning token, not a magic constant.

Primary interaction: first thing a reader would click on the 1280 shot is the Journey card (top-left, and named by the intro sentence). ui-test plan clicked it (scoped selector .page--design.active-page a[href=...], the columns-page two-selectors trap from the skill) - confirmed it opens /imagine/design/journey/ with 451 real screenshots, label matches destination exactly. Not a finding: control works, labeled correctly, navigates correctly. Re-verified after the page.js fix (previews() card link) - same result, 451 imgs, zero console errors on both runs.

FIX 2 - added public/imagine/design/readme.md (this realm had zero readme.md files - CLAUDE.md requires one per module - only child/controls/ has one). Kept to the What/Use/Watch-out/More shape, names the 2026-09-04 fix and points at this task dir for the before/after shots. CAVEAT: the other 10 children (journey, padding, scale, layout, navigation, color, type, vocabulary, system, themes) still have no readme.md - out of this passes budget to write 10 accurate ones (each needs its own studys methodology written up, controls/readme.md is the ~500-word bar); logged as PROPOSED, not fixed, because it does not affect the live pages ten-second test, only its dev-facing doc index.

assign.outcome:
**Design realm now passes the ten-second test.** The landing page (`/imagine/design/`) rendered its 11 children as a bare word list (Journey, Padding, Scale, Layout, Navigation, Color, Type, Controls, Vocabulary, System, Themes) in the default ~40em column, with no explanation of what any word meant — exactly the failure `paging/critique` had already caught: 31% of 3440 used, 2180px dead, `score: 99` (highest taste score in the set) on a page a stranger cannot read. Root cause: `design/page.js` called `this.columns()` but is nested inside `/imagine/`'s own columns host, so the call was dead code (doc/columns.md's "shallowest ancestor" rule) — the page fell back to the narrow default column word while literally every one of its own children already wears `width: "full"`.

**Fixed** — [`/imagine/design/page.js`](/imagine/design/page.js): removed the dead `columns()` call; added `width: "full"` (matching every sibling), `index: true` + `this.previews()` (the tile-wall pattern `padding/` and `layout/` already build, named verbatim in the critique's `alt`); rewrote the opening line in plain words — what Journey is, what the other cards do, what to click. Measured live after the fix: **97% of 3440 used**, dead space down to ~50px (the column's own inset, not waste), intro paragraph exactly at the 40em measure cap (not over). Primary interaction (the Journey card) verified working before and after with a `ui-test` plan — opens `/imagine/design/journey/`, 451 real screenshots, zero console errors. Also added [`/imagine/design/readme.md`](/imagine/design/readme.md) — the realm had none.

**Left open, with a reason** — the other 10 children (`journey/ padding/ scale/ layout/ navigation/ color/ type/ vocabulary/ system/ themes/`) still have no `readme.md` (only `controls/` does); writing 10 accurate ones needs each study's own methodology written up and was out of this pass's budget — proposed, not fixed, and it does not touch what a stranger sees on the live page.
